systemicResidualRootCause: The prior validator judged operative-claim plausibility but not (a) required-issue-key/exception/alternative coverage and (b) whether displayed sources are specifically relevant to the exact proposition. So a tax-fluent but incomplete (Q5), overbroad 'only' (Q35), or non-responsive/foundational-cited (Q41) answer could still be VERIFIED_CONTROLLING.
validatorModel: gpt-4o-mini (only model available on the API key; retained with stronger structured grounding + a deterministic foundational-citation gate)

architecture.deterministicFoundationalCitationGate: citesOnlyFoundationalProvisions(sources): if every displayed authority is only a foundational/jurisdictional NIRC provision (Secs 1-6), it cannot support a specific rate/form/penalty -> fail closed. Catches Q35 (NIRC Sec 2) and Q41 (NIRC Secs 2-3).
architecture.strengthenedValidatorSchema: The controlled evaluator now returns answerResponsive, primaryIssueAnswered, requiredIssueKeysCovered, materialExceptionsCovered, materialAlternativesCovered, citationRelevant, citationSupportsProposition, materiallyComplete, unsupportedMaterialProposition, eligibleForVerifiedControlling. All positive gates required; any false / malformed / timeout / unavailable fails closed. Backward-compatible with PHASE-10A8 field names.
architecture.precisionCalibration: Coverage gates only required when the question implies an exception/alternative; simple correct factual answers (deadline/rate) are not penalized.
